^4Ascendancy selection order 1 - Commander of Darkness 2 - Mindless Aggretion 3 - Bone Barrier 4 - Unnature Strengt ^1^xFFFF775 - Prolonged Servitude (Replace Commander of Darkness after you get Catarina Bloodline) ^7 ^1=== CAP RES & DEX WITH GEAR === Spectres: ^4Use Carnage Chieftains from act 2
^4You want one ghastly eye jewel with taunt on hit and one with blind on hit
Dont use AG until gem level at least lvl 18,
Try to keep around 30-40 mana unreserved even if it means not maxing vitality aura.
^xAF6025^5LOW BUDGET NOTE^7 ^xE05030Your AG is still squishy in this stage. OK to farm T16, but not suggest to do T17 ^7 ^x8888FFTestudo^4 is a very cheap anoint you can get early for high attack block chance, block recovery and 30 life each time you block an attack. You want to anoint ^1As the Mountain ^4later for more block chance.
^4Dont level vitality to high.
Buy a Vaal haste.
^1^xAF6025^xD02090^5MEDIUM BUDGET NOTE^7^7^7
^xFFFF77Use Mask of Stitiched Demon on your AG ASAP!!, so you can go T17. Can also use Garb of the Ephemeral on your AG body to become crit immune. ^7
